title.zh: 针刺手法量学：捻转补泻的两个定义、四大要素与“以……为度”的终点指标
title.en: Manipulation Dosage: Two Definitions of Twirling Tonify/Reduce, the Four Elements, and Endpoint Indices ("until ...")

summary.zh: 石学敏认为补泻手法都是机械刺激，必有“剂量”，历代却没有量。他给捻转补泻立了两个定义（作用力方向向心为补、离心为泻；小幅度高频率为补、大幅度低频率为泻），又提出四大要素：方向、大小、施术时间（每穴1~3分钟）、两次施术间隔（3~6小时），再用“抽动3次”“眼球湿润”等效应作终点。
summary.en: Shi holds that every tonifying or reducing manipulation is mechanical stimulation and so has a dose that the tradition never measured. He gives twirling two definitions (force direction centripetal = tonify, centrifugal = reduce; small-amplitude high-frequency = tonify, large-amplitude low-frequency = reduce) and four elements: direction, size, duration (1-3 min per point) and interval (3-6 hours), and he ends manipulation at effect endpoints such as "three twitches" or "eyes moist".

takeaways.zh: 问题意识：所有针刺手法从性质上说都是机械性刺激，无论补泻都涉及刺激量，可是历代医家没搞清补泻该用多大的“剂量”；近代通行的“大指向前为补、向后为泻”“幅度小用力轻为补、幅度大用力重为泻”，一无体位交代，二无轻重大小的量学概念。他的目标是让针刺“由定性的补泻上升到定量的水平”，使之规范、可重复、可操作。
takeaways.en: His problem: all needling manipulations are mechanical stimuli, so tonifying or reducing involves a stimulus dose, yet earlier physicians never settled what dose; the recent rules "thumb forward tonifies, backward reduces" and "small and light tonifies, large and heavy reduces" neither state the posture nor quantify light and heavy. His aim is to lift needling "from qualitative tonify/reduce to a quantitative level", standardised, repeatable and operable.

takeaways.zh: 第一定义管方向：以任督二脉为中心，医者面对患者，两手拇指开始捻转时作用力的切线方向向心者为补，离心者为泻。落到左右侧：左侧顺时针、右侧逆时针（相对患者）为补；左侧逆时针、右侧顺时针为泻。操作是捻转时加力、倒转时自然退回，一捻一转连续不断。内关泻法的例子：左手拇指示指顺时针、右手逆时针，两手拇指作用力方向都是离心。
takeaways.en: The first definition governs direction: taking the Ren and Du channels as the centre, with the physician facing the patient, the tangential direction of the thumb's force at the start of twirling is tonifying when centripetal and reducing when centrifugal. By side: left clockwise and right counterclockwise (relative to the patient) tonify; left counterclockwise and right clockwise reduce. The action adds force on the twirl and lets the needle return by itself, continuously. Example, Neiguan reduction: left hand clockwise, right hand counterclockwise, so both thumbs push centrifugally.

takeaways.zh: 第二定义管幅度与频率：补法是小幅度（小于90°）、高频率（每分钟120转以上）；泻法是大幅度（大于180°）、低频率（每分钟50~60转）。补时术者手指轻轻捻转，然后自然退回，形成有节奏的频率，“徐徐地激发经气”；泻时手指、腕及全臂协调用力，作用力较大，能迅速激发经气，气至病所。任督二脉的经穴多取小幅度高频率为补，大幅度低频率为泻。
takeaways.en: The second definition governs amplitude and frequency: tonifying is small amplitude (under 90 degrees) and high frequency (over 120 turns per minute); reducing is large amplitude (over 180 degrees) and low frequency (50-60 turns per minute). Tonifying is a light finger twirl that springs back, a rhythmic frequency that "slowly stimulates channel qi"; reducing recruits fingers, wrist and whole arm with greater force to stimulate qi quickly and bring it to the disease site. On Ren and Du points, small-amplitude high-frequency is generally tonifying and large-amplitude low-frequency reducing.

takeaways.zh: “四大要素”有两种说法，内容一致：作用力方向、作用力大小（幅度与频率）、施术持续时间、两次针刺的间隔时间（即一次针刺后疗效持续的时间）。绪言把它们列为“捻转手法的四大要素”，并另外把每个辅穴的取穴体位、针刺方向、针刺深度、手法类型也算作要固定的量学指标。
takeaways.en: The "four elements" are stated in two ways with the same content: force direction, force size (amplitude and frequency), duration of manipulation, and interval between two needlings (that is, how long the effect of one needling lasts). The preface calls them the four elements of twirling and also counts posture, needle direction, depth and manipulation type for each auxiliary point as indices to be fixed.

takeaways.zh: 施术时间的参数是每穴1~3分钟：他批评《针灸甲乙经》只留一呼一吸或两呼两吸，达不到治疗作用，这个参数是对正经361穴和经外50余穴考察对比后提出的。具体如：无脉症太渊、人迎各1分钟；改善脑供血的风池等穴3分钟最佳；支气管哮喘每穴1分钟，听诊哮鸣音仍在说明“还未达治疗量”，就继续运针，最长约3分钟。
takeaways.en: The duration parameter is 1-3 minutes per point: he criticises the Jiayi Jing's single or double breath as far short of a therapeutic effect, and says the parameter was derived by comparing the 361 regular points and over 50 extra points. Examples: Taiyuan and Renying each 1 minute in pulseless disease; Fengchi and others 3 minutes as the best to improve cerebral blood supply; in bronchial asthma 1 minute per point, and if wheeze is still audible "the therapeutic dose has not been reached", so continue, up to about 3 minutes.

takeaways.zh: 间隔要素是说每次针刺都有一个持续的疗效期，因病而异：针人迎治中风，一次的最佳作用时间为6小时（针后约20分钟脑血流改变最明显，6小时后供血开始衰减，故应6小时蓄积一次）；针刺治支气管哮喘，捻转补法1~3分钟后最佳有效时间可达3~4小时。据此他把两次施术间隔的最佳参数定为3~6小时。
takeaways.en: The interval element means each needling has an effect period that varies with disease: needling Renying for stroke gives a best duration of 6 hours (cerebral blood flow changes most about 20 minutes after needling and supply starts to fade after 6 hours, so needle again every 6 hours); in bronchial asthma the best effect after 1-3 minutes of twirling tonification can last 3-4 hours. He therefore sets the best interval between needlings at 3-6 hours.

takeaways.zh: “度”是终点指标，深度是另一个剂量：他说针刺深度实际上是决定刺激量的另一重要参数。醒脑开窍的每一针都有可观察的终点：三阴交与极泉、尺泽、委中提插至患侧肢体抽动3次，水沟雀啄至眼球湿润或流泪，合谷透三间至示指伸直；外伤性截瘫夹脊针刺，用提插使胸椎夹脊有躯体紧束感、腰椎夹脊向外生殖器及双下肢放射；哮喘听诊哮鸣音消失为止。
takeaways.en: The endpoint is the "degree", and depth is another dose: he says needling depth is in fact another important parameter fixing stimulus dose. Every needle in Xingnao Kaiqiao has an observable endpoint: Sanyinjiao, Jiquan, Chize and Weizhong lifted and thrust until the affected limb twitches three times, Shuigou sparrow-pecked until the eyes moisten or tear, Hegu through to Sanjian until the index finger extends; in incomplete traumatic paraplegia Jiaji needled by lifting-thrusting until the thoracic Jiaji gives a tight band around the trunk and the lumbar Jiaji radiates to the genitals and both legs; in asthma until wheeze vanishes on auscultation.

takeaways.zh: 为什么要这样死抠：他做了对照。发病10天内的缺血性中风60例，双盲，同用醒脑开窍诸穴，一组规范量学，一组传统手法，治疗前指标无差异，治疗后血液流变学、血脂7项均有“极显著性差异”，结论是效果不但与选穴配方有关，也与手法差异关系很大。他同时承认个体差异，要按体质肥瘦调整，“但不能因此而认为针刺手法的刺激量是不能确定的”。后期他又把研究推进到时间、频率、方向几个要素的交互作用（见下节）。
takeaways.en: Why he insists on this: he ran a comparison. In 60 cases of ischaemic stroke within 10 days of onset, double-blind, the same Xingnao Kaiqiao points were needled with standardised dosage in one group and traditional manipulation in the other; indices did not differ before treatment, after treatment haemorheology and seven lipid indices differed "extremely significantly", and he concludes that outcome depends on manipulation as well as points. He admits individual variation and adjusts for build, "but this does not mean the stimulus dose cannot be fixed". Later he extended the work to interaction among time, frequency and direction (see the section below).

h.zh: 后来的量效研究：要素之间会互相影响
h.en: Later dose-response work: the elements interact

body.zh: 全集绪言与第五章还记了他90年代以后的研究：选择已有成熟经验的“穴—病”组合（内关—缺血性中风、合谷—中枢性面瘫、风池—椎基底动脉供血不足），用行针时间、捻转频率、针刺方向三要素做量效研究，再用代谢组学和基因芯片探机理。书中的读法是：针刺手法的“量”是穴位、时间、频率、方向等众多要素组合出来的综合量，各要素之间的交互作用也是关键因素。结果举例：内关—缺血性中风（大鼠模型）显示较快频率整体较优，且需先保证恰当的行针时间，再选合适的频率；合谷—中枢性面瘫，斜刺行针5秒疗效最佳。
body.en: The Quanji preface and chapter 5 also record his later work: taking established point-disease pairs (Neiguan for ischaemic stroke, Hegu for central facial paralysis, Fengchi for vertebrobasilar insufficiency), he studied dose-response over needling time, twirling frequency and direction, then probed mechanisms with metabolomics and gene chips. The reading in the book is that the "quantity" of manipulation is a composite of point, time, frequency, direction and so on, and that interaction among elements is itself key. Examples: Neiguan for ischaemic stroke (rat model) favoured faster frequencies overall, first securing an appropriate needling time and then choosing a frequency; Hegu for central facial paralysis was best with oblique needling for 5 seconds.

h.zh: 提插、雀啄怎样进入量学
h.en: How lifting-thrusting and sparrow-pecking enter the scheme

body.zh: 绪言说对提插手法也提出了“提插形式、针刺效应及效应程度”的量学标准，但书中只给出穴位层面的例子：三阴交“重插轻提”为补，极泉、尺泽、委中提插为泻，都以肢体抽动3次为度；水沟用雀啄，且全集写明先将针向一个方向捻转360°，再雀啄，以眼球湿润或流泪为效应指标；印堂用“轻雀啄”，也以流泪或眼球湿润为度。书中没有给提插的次数、幅度或雀啄频率的数值。
body.en: The preface says lifting-thrusting also received quantitative standards for "form, effect and degree of effect", but the books give only point-level examples: Sanyinjiao "heavy thrust, light lift" to tonify, Jiquan, Chize and Weizhong lifted and thrust to reduce, all ended at three limb twitches; Shuigou is sparrow-pecked, the Quanji specifying first twirling the needle 360 degrees in one direction and then pecking, with moist or tearing eyes as the effect index; Yintang gets a "light peck" with the same endpoint. No numbers are given for the count, amplitude or pecking frequency of lifting-thrusting.

how_to_use.zh: 读他的处方时，不要只看“施捻转泻法”，要找四个数：这一针的方向（向心还是离心）、幅度与频率、施术多久、隔多久再针一次；再找“以……为度”的终点。没有终点的地方（如内关），用时间当终点。自己核对时注意：全集与实用针灸学对同一穴的深度、时间常有差异（见 caveats），以他在具体病种下给出的数字为准。
how_to_use.en: When reading his prescriptions do not stop at "twirling reduction"; look for four numbers: the direction of this needle (centripetal or centrifugal), amplitude and frequency, how long to work it, how long until the next needling; then find the "until ..." endpoint. Where there is none (Neiguan) time is the endpoint. Note that the Quanji and the Practical often differ in depth and time for the same point (see caveats); prefer the numbers he gives under the specific disease.

caveats.zh: 书中同一参数并不总是一致：泻法幅度在同一节写作“大于180°”，另一句写“<360°”；内关深度全集写1.0~1.5寸、实用针灸学写0.5~1.0寸，施术时间全集写1~3分钟、实用写1分钟；两次施术间隔既有“6小时”（绪言，以人迎—中风为例）又有“3~6小时”（一般参数）。频率与幅度的“最佳”多来自作者单位的临床与动物实验（如大鼠MCAO），书中未把大鼠实验中“较快频率较优”与临床泻法50~60转/分的规定做调和。文中“抢转”为识别错误，应为“捻转”。
caveats.en: The books are not always consistent on one parameter: the reducing amplitude is ">180 degrees" in one place and "<360 degrees" in another within the same section; Neiguan depth is 1.0-1.5 cun in the Quanji and 0.5-1.0 cun in the Practical, time 1-3 min versus 1 min; the interval is "6 hours" (preface, Renying for stroke) and "3-6 hours" (general). The "optimal" values largely come from the authors' own clinical and animal work (for example rat MCAO), and the books do not reconcile "faster frequency is better" in rats with the clinical reducing rule of 50-60 turns per minute.
